title: quercus robur subsp. fastigiata
intro: Quercus robur subsp. fastigiata, commonly known as the fastigiate English oak, is a subspecies of deciduous tree belonging to the Quercus robur species. This plant is rich in medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health issues, offering benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Quercus robur subsp. fastigiata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to exhibit cardiovascular protective effects, anti-cancer properties, and neuroprotective actions, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
